title: studio asset manifest (assets/MANIFEST.json)
description: One row per asset file a studio skill produces or reuses. Written for skills/SPEC-studio.md, shared contract item 5. Cross-field rules that a schema cannot state (no duplicate files, a paid service must have been named in the brief, files exist, masters stay out of the import path) are in validate_manifest.py.

path.description: relative to the project root, forward slashes, no leading slash, no .. segment

seed_or_params.description: the seed, or the parameters that make the file again (a jsfxr string, a command line, 'hand-drawn')

model.description: the model and version when one made the file, else null

weights_license.description: the license or terms of the weights, as read from the model card; required when model is set

source.description: where reused material came from (a URL or a catalog row), else null

source_license.description: the license of the reused material; required when source is set

reference_used_as.description: how a reference image entered the process; none when there was no reference

master.description: the editable source, kept outside the engine's import path

build_script.description: the script that makes this export from its master, rerunnable

text.description: text drawn into an image: each exact string and the font file it was drawn from

consent_record.description: the written consent for a real person's likeness or voice, when one appears
